Name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
Notes: 240-acre garden with ~1,854 plant species; commissioned by Hyder Ali, completed by Tipu Sultan

Name: Cubbon Park
Notes: 300-acre green belt with over 6,000 trees, designed by Richard Sankey

Name: Bangalore Palace
Notes: Tudor-style palace built 1887 by Chamaraja Wadeyar

Name: Bull Temple
Notes: 16th-century temple with giant monolithic Nandi bull, built by Kempe Gowda

Name: Tipu Sultan's Fort and Palace
Notes: Two-storey teakwood palace, now a museum

Name: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium
Notes: Established 1989; hybrid projection system and sky theatre

Name: VV Puram Food Street
Notes: Bustling street food hub, especially at night

Name: Aviation Museum
Notes: Lesser-known museum showcasing aircraft and aviation memorabilia

Name: Empire Restaurant
Notes: Known for shawarma rolls, coin parottas, and chicken kebabs

Name: Nandini Deluxe
Notes: Andhra-style spicy chicken curries and biryani

Name: Sankranti
Notes: Hidden-gem serving Karnataka regional dishes incl. Bisi Bele Bath and Neer Dosa

Name: RNR Biryani
Notes: Fragrant basmati biryani with marinated meats
